source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
Once per battle, this unit can be targeted with [Command Re-roll](vsdata:ability/core.command-re-roll) for 0CP, even if that Stratagem has already been used on another unit during the phase.

**Designer's Note**: keep an Incensor Cherub token beside the unit, and take it away once the unit has used this ability.
